headline: Karoline Leavitt 🍼💨 BOUNCES from WH mic 🎤👋 for toddler duty 🧸💕
text: Karoline Leavitt 👩‍💼🍼, the 28-year-old youngest press secretary ever 🥇🗣️, just DROPPED the mic 🎤💥 to go full-time MOM MODE 🍼👩‍👧‍👦 with her two tiny tots 🧒👶! President Trump 🍊👑 called her his 'most trusted aide' 🤝🫡 and says he 'totally gets' the family pivot, adding she'll still be a top outside advisor and MAGA mouthpiece 🐘📢. The New Hampshire native 🚗🇺🇸 had the gig since last year after climbing the ranks from first-term assistant press secretary 📝 to Trump campaign spokesperson 🗳️🔥, plus a failed 2022 congressional run against Chris Pappas 🗳️😤. During her tenure she SEIZED the press pool 🏆📰, clashed with the White House Correspondents' Association 😡🎙️, and kept the 'Gulf of America' name on lock 🔒🇺🇸. Fox News fangirl Riley Gaines 🦈📺 called her 'so good at her job' after a fiery briefing-room clash 💥🗣️. Now Karoline's trading the podium for playground duty 🛝🍪, leaving Trump to find press secretary number SIX 🧮📣, with heavy hitters like JD Vance 🦅, Marco Rubio 🌴, and Doug Burgum 🦬 already subbing in. Stephen Miller 👔🧠 says their bromance continues 'every single day' 🤝, while Karoline tweets her job was 'the honor and adventure of a lifetime' 🏆✨. Bittersweet exit? More like a win-win for family values and MAGA future 💼➡️👨‍👩‍👧‍👦!
